sentences.en: The strong wind cut the electric wires in several places.
sentences.zh: 强风在几处切断了电线。

sentences.en: Thanks to electric goods, housewives have plenty of free time.
sentences.zh: 多亏了家用电器，家庭主妇有很多空闲时间。

sentences.en: Heat was spread throughout the room by the electric stove.
sentences.zh: 电炉将热量传遍整个房间。

senses.zh: 电的；导电的；电动的；发电的；令人震惊的
